sovereign_country.strategic_role: 苏伊士运河经济特区、辐射中东及北非的低成本轻工制造

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Developer Infrastructure, Database and API Monitoring Cloud

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: civil law (Napoleonic/French code) supplemented by Islamic Sharia as a principal source of legislation and administrative/regulatory decrees.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Agreement between the Arab Republic of Egypt and the United States of America Concerning the Encouragement and Reciprocal Protection of Investments (entered into force 1992)
Agreement establishing the Euro-Mediterranean Association between the European Communities and Egypt (O.J. 2004, in force 2004)
Unified Agreement for the Investment of Capital in the Arab Countries (1980; amended version in force among Arab League states)
Convention between Egypt and the United States for the Avoidance of Double Taxation (in force for income taxes)
COMESA Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa Treaty (Egypt is a member)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing (AML Act), as last amended by Law No. 8 of 2022; Executive Regulations of the AML Act (Prime Ministerial Decree No. 95 of 2003 as amended); Commercial Companies Law No. 159 of 1981; Investment Law No. 194 of 2020 and its Executive Regulations and GAFI implementing decisions on the Beneficial Owners Register; Central Bank of Egypt and Financial Regulatory Authority AML/CFT instructions.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Authenticated copy of each Ultimate Beneficial Owner's international passport
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent national passport authority / Egyptian consular officer

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the Egyptian incorporation counsel and authorized local representatives
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the foreign shareholders' jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing and incumbency of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or authority of the shareholder's place of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Arabic translation of the above documents by a sworn translator
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Sworn translator registered with the Egyptian Ministry of Justice

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-clearance screening of every shareholder, director, settlor, trustee and UBO against the Egyptian domestic terrorism list, GAFI's AML watch list, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN/Non-SDN lists, EU consolidated financial sanctions, and relevant Arab League sanctions. Enhanced due diligence and specific senior-management approval for PEPs, qualified investors, high-risk third countries, and threshold remittances; continuous monitoring during incorporation and a suspicious transaction report (STR) obligation to the Egyptian Financial Intelligence Unit (ECU) under Law No. 80 of 2002.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) — company registration One-Stop Shop / Commercial Registry module at gafi.gov.eg
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered LLC name must be in Arabic script; a foreign/Latin brand may be appended as a transliterated trade name, but the Arabic name is the sole statutory commercial name. The name must end with the LLC form designation, be distinguishable from existing registered names, and avoid misleading or contrary-to-order indications. Latin-only names are not accepted for commercial registration.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: On rejection the applicant may file a written administrative reconsideration with the GAFI Commercial Registration Complaints Committee within 15 working days, attaching alternative names. If the administrative objection is denied, a second rejection may be challenged in the Judicial Administrative Court of the Egyptian Council of State within 60 days of the notification. During the appeal period the applicant may simultaneously reserve three new alternative names, and any pending name reservation is automatically extended until the final administrative act.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as the sole registered office for an Egyptian LLC. A physical Egyptian address is mandatory for GAFI-commercial-registry purposes, service of process, and the availability of corporate books. A dedicated desk in a licensed serviced-office provider may be used only if the provider permits signage, accepts regulatory notices, and allows unannounced GAFI/tax inspections. For a remote DevOps/API company, the physical office can be small but cannot be a pure virtual mailbox.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate for an active low-risk cloud-infrastructure company: estimated unannounced on-site inspection probability of 10-15% in the first year, decreasing to about 5-10% annually for compliant entities maintaining a physical office and accurate UBO register; the probability rises above 25% when a virtual-only or low-substance office is used.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability search and name reservation for up to three alternative trade names
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory administrative tariff under GAFI fees schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: GAFI incorporation registration fee for a limited liability company (standard LLC deed review, commercial registration, publication)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: GAFI / Commercial Registry at the Ministry of Trade and Industry

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Egyptian notarization of the Arabic Articles of Association and founding minutes
Sworn Arabic translation of foreign constitutional documents, passports, powers of attorney and utility proofs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate per Arabic page plus notary attestation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Consular legalization of certified copies and corporate good-standing certificates of foreign shareholders
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Egyptian Consulate in the source jurisdiction (or designated legalization agency)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular statutory fee and agency handling fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank reference letter and UBO/CDD background screening package (AML screening against sanctions, PEP, and adverse-media datasets)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial bank providing the reference and online screening vendor
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bank tariff plus vendor per-record background screening fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Initial registered-office fact-finding, due-diligence inspection, and physical lease/serviced-office contribution for six months
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rental benchmark in a business-class Cairo/Giza IT zone

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: External legal counsel pre-incorporation advisory, drafting, negotiation, submission to GAFI and follow-up until commercial registration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Egyptian law office/Attorney before the Courts
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed and success-stage professional fee prevailing in the Egyptian corporate legal market

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egypt Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended), provisions governing Limited Liability Companies (Articles on LLC formation, share subscription, managers, and registration); Investment Law No. 72 of 2017; Executive Regulations of the Investment Law (as amended); Law No. 151 of 2020 on Data Protection as applicable to software activities; Egyptian Civil Code rules on notarization and mandate.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) — Investor Services One-Stop-Shop, Cairo, Egypt; final commercial registration through the Commercial Registry under the Ministry of Investment.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Incorporation Application (Model LLC-01) together with the Notarized Contract of Formation (Memorandum and Articles of Association) executed before the Egyptian Notary Public.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under Egypt Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 for an LLC; founders may declare nominal share capital sufficient for the business purpose. Escrow deposit is not mandatory for registration; if bank deposit is used, a certificate from a licensed Egyptian bank is needed. No escrow account rule applies unless the company seeks Investment Law project incentives requiring a capital transfer certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The undersigned member/shareholders of [Company Name] LLC, having approved the Formation Contract on [date], hereby resolve as follows: (1) the share capital of EGP [X] is freely subscribed in full by the founding shareholders, with each share entitled to equal voting rights; (2) the registered office is fixed at [street address], Cairo, Egypt, as stated in the Notarized Formation Contract; (3) [Name A] is appointed General Manager and legal representative, and [Name B] is appointed Financial Officer and alternate legal representative, each with full authority to open bank accounts, sign contracts, and represent the company before GAFI, the Commercial Registry, and the tax authorities; (4) all incorporation and filing actions are authorized.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Availability Search and Pre-Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Investor Services One-Stop-Shop / GAFI electronic portal (www.gafi.gov.eg)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a name reservation application through the GAFI online portal or in person at the One-Stop-Shop, proposing three alternative names in transliterated Arabic and English. The system checks conflicts against the Commercial Registry name database and any similar trademarks. Upon approval, the name is reserved for six months. Pay the name reservation fee and obtain the official reservation certificate.
required_dossiers: Passport copies of all founding shareholders
Copy of founders' commercial registration if any shareholder is an existing entity
Power of attorney if applicant is a third-party representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or prohibited wording, file a written objection with the GAFI Name Committee within 15 days, or amend and resubmit the name reservation with an alternative mark; a rejection on technical grounds can be cured by removing generic or misleading terms.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Formation Contract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Office / Tawthiq Department, Ministry of Justice
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the bilingual (Arabic/English) Contract of Formation in accordance with Law No. 159 of 1981, including company name, registered office, object, share capital, shareholder details, manager appointments, and duration. All founders or their legal representatives must sign the contract in person before the Notary Public. The notary verifies identity, witnesses the signatures, and issues a certified notarial copy. Ensure the company object expressly covers software development, DevOps tools, database and API monitoring, and cloud infrastructure services.
required_dossiers: Draft Contract of Formation (Arabic and English)
Valid passports or national IDs of all shareholders
Commercial registration certificate of any corporate shareholder
Corporate resolution of any institutional investor authorizing the subscription
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary issues a query regarding capacity, translation, or signature authenticity, correct the deficiency, obtain required apostilles or consular legalization for foreign shareholders, and rebook a notarial appointment; no substantive appeal is available against notary formal requirements.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Incorporation Filing and Commercial Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) — Investors Services One-Stop-Shop
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the incorporation application model LLC-01 together with the notarized Contract of Formation and all supporting documents at the GAFI One-Stop-Shop counter or electronically through the GAFI portal. Pay the official filing fees at the treasury window. GAFI reviews the object, capital, shareholders, and office legalization. Upon approval, GAFI issues the Certificate of Incorporation and forwards the file to the Commercial Registry for the final registration entry and issuance of the Commercial Registration Certificate.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the registered office lease or title deed
Power of attorney for the incorporation agent, if any
Bank certificate of capital deposit, if capital was deposited
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI issues a query or rejection, the founders may submit an explanatory memorandum within 15 days, correct the flagged defects, or request a desktop review through the GAFI Investor Grievance Committee; unresolved disputes may be escalated to the Investment Dispute Resolution Mechanism under Law No. 72 of 2017.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Card Registration and VAT Enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) — Investment One-Stop-Shop Desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete ETA Form 1 (tax card application), declaring the company's activity, legal form, capital, and estimated turnover under ISIC 6201. Submit the required documents at the ETA office of the company's tax jurisdiction or through the GAFI one-stop-shop delegation. ETA issues the Tax Card, reflecting the establishment registration and enabling customs and banking transactions. Enroll for VAT if expected supplies exceed the mandatory registration threshold or voluntarily if the company intends to reclaim input VAT.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Tax Card application is delayed, file a formal written reminder with the ETA Central Department; if rejection occurs due to data mismatch, correct the Commercial Registry records first and resubmit; complaints may be raised to the ETA Internal Consultation Unit within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Office Civil Defense and Occupational Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Administration of Civil Defense, Ministry of Interior; Ministry of Manpower Occupational Safety and Health Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: For the physical office serving as registered head office, submit an occupancy clearance application to the Civil Defense Administration covering fire safety equipment, emergency exits, and electrical loads for the server room and developer workstations. Arrange an inspection of the premises; obtain the Civil Defense Clearance Certificate. Register the workplace and pay the occupational injury insurance contribution with the National Organization for Social Insurance if local personnel are hired. No industrial establishment license is required because the activity is office-based software and cloud infrastructure.
required_dossiers: Insurance policy for fire and casualty, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If Civil Defense inspection findings are adverse, install the required fire suppression or exits and request a re-inspection within a short statutory turnaround; if clearance is denied on a question of structural safety, obtain a licensed engineer's report and reapply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — pure software, DevOps tools, database and API monitoring, and cloud infrastructure services do not require an industrial production license under Egyptian law. GAFI retains general investment licensing oversight, while the National Telecom Regulatory Authority (NTRA) is consulted only if the company operates public telecommunications or data hosting services reselling capacity to the public.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Statutory License Exemption Notice (Office-Based ISIC 6201 DevTools and Cloud Monitoring Services)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (Category C — Administrative Registration Not Required) for ISIC 6201 office-based information services with no manufacturing, no combustion, and no discharge; a simple confirmation letter from the office building management is sufficient for the One-Stop-Shop file.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No statutory wastewater or VOC emission limits apply absent an industrial process; compliance with Law No. 4 of 1994 general housekeeping standards, municipal office wastewater connection requirements under Law No. 93 of 1962, and low-noise operation of server cooling units; disposal of IT equipment and e-waste through licensed recyclers in accordance with EEAA waste-management rules.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety and civil defense inspection certificate required for the registered office and any server-hosting room, issued by the Egyptian Civil Defense Authority before occupancy; occupational health and safety registration with the Ministry of Manpower; structural load verification from the premises owner or municipality if heavy battery arrays or generators are installed; workers' compensation enrollment with the National Organization for Social Insurance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) — official registration and compliance portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Egyptian LLC must register with the Egyptian Tax Authority by filing the standard tax registration form through the ETA portal or at the competent tax office. Required documents include the certified incorporation certificate, commercial registry extract, chamber of commerce certificate, board resolution or power of attorney identifying the appointed local tax representative, and copies of managers' passports or national IDs. The ETA issues a unified Tax Identification Number (TIN) that doubles as the VAT identification number. Non-resident shareholders are permitted, but a resident tax representative may be required for notices and audits.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists under Egyptian tax law. An Egyptian LLC is automatically treated as a resident corporate taxpayer subject to entity-level corporate income tax on worldwide income. No hybrid entity election is available for domestic LLCs; anti-hybrid and controlled-foreign-company rules under Law No. 91 of 2005 and related ministerial decrees apply. Certain investment incentives and free-zone regimes require separate application to the General Authority for Investment and are not default elections.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Egyptian Law No. 67 of 2016
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory VAT registration is triggered when annual taxable supplies exceed EGP 500,000. Voluntary registration is permitted below this threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Egypt operates a mandatory electronic invoicing and e-receipt system administered by the Egyptian Tax Authority. VAT-registered taxpayers above the phased turnover thresholds must integrate their ERP/billing systems with the ETA's e-invoice platform using authorized APIs and XML/JSON data formats. Each invoice is submitted in real time, validated fiscally by the ETA, and returned with a unique QR code and digital stamp. Issuance of unvalidated invoices, delayed clearance, or non-integration can result in blocked invoice generation, restrictions on tax registrations, and statutory penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rated VAT at 0% applies to tangible goods physically exported from Egypt to outside the customs territory. For offshore services, zero-rating is available when the services are supplied to a non-resident recipient, the benefit or economic consumption occurs entirely outside Egypt, and the consideration for the services is received in foreign currency through an Egyptian bank channel. The exporter must retain contemporaneous documentary evidence demonstrating the overseas destination and actual receipt of consideration in Egypt.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Executed service contract or purchase order for offshore service exports
ETA-approved e-invoice bearing the validation QR code
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Egyptian Tax Authority and customs authorities may retrospectively audit zero-rated export transactions. If the statutory export documentation, foreign-currency receipt, or offshore consumption evidence is deficient, the claimed zero-rating is disallowed and the transaction is recharacterized as taxable at the standard 14% VAT rate. Late-payment fines, delay interest, and administrative penalties apply from the original due date. Fraudulent export zero-rating claims or falsified inward remittance or customs documentation may give rise to criminal liability, monetary penalties, customs confiscation, and exclusion from the electronic invoice clearance system.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), exercising exclusive regulatory jurisdiction under Law No. 194 of 2020 (the Central Bank and Banking System Law) over foreign exchange dealings, monetary policy, licensing of authorized banks and FX dealers, and cross-border capital movements in the Arab Republic of Egypt.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The EGP operates under a market-driven flexible exchange rate regime formally adopted on 6 March 2024 within the IMF Extended Fund Facility framework. Current account transactions (cross-border service fees, SaaS subscriptions, DevOps/API monitoring revenues) are effectively convertible and require no prior CBE approval, only underlying invoice/contract documentation. Capital account transactions (foreign equity subscriptions, shareholder loans, dividend repatriation, loan repayments) are freely transferable in the same foreign currency for entities under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 (GAFI-registered projects), subject to bank-level documentary checks and CBE-related transfer registration. Residual practical hurdles include: (i) strict inward remittance declaration forms, (ii) bank balance-sheet foreign-currency liquidity management during periods of exchange pressure, and (iii) enhanced OFAC/FATF counterparty screening on beneficiaries, particularly for cloud infrastructure payments routed through correspondent banks in the US and EU.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds from digital and cloud services (SaaS subscriptions, API monitoring, database infrastructure) must be repatriated to a CBE-authorized bank account in Egypt within 180 days from the invoice date or the contractually agreed settlement date, whichever first occurs. Under the prevailing post-2024 flexible exchange regime there is no mandatory conversion requirement: the exporter may retain 100% of collected foreign currency in an onshore Foreign Currency Account (FCA) at an authorized bank. However, each credit entry must be routed through a licensed Egyptian FX dealer and must be accompanied by an export invoice (faturah), the underlying service contract, and a foreign currency source declaration form. In practice banks require the matching SWIFT MT103 narrative to reference the commercial invoice number and the LLC's Commercial Registry number, and the transaction must be reflected in the annual audited financial statements to preserve future dividend repatriation eligibility.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Mercury, Wise Business, Revolut Business) cannot act as the primary settlement bank for the Egyptian LLC because CBE foreign-exchange rules require 100% repatriation of export-derived proceeds to an account held at a licensed Egyptian bank within 180 days. EMIs, however, may be deployed as supplementary collection rails for high-frequency US SaaS billing (e.g., Stripe Billing, Mercury ACH sweeps) provided that: (i) the EMI account is denominated in USD and owned by the Egyptian LLC; (ii) all accumulated balances are swept via SWIFT MT103 to the primary Egyptian bank; and (iii) no EGP-denominated liabilities are incurred offshore. Legal constraints specific to Egypt: unlicensed e-money operations targeting Egyptian residents are prohibited under Law No. 18 of 2019; offshore EMIs have restrictive country-risk policies concerning Egyptian-registered legal entities, making onboarding materially slower and subject to enhanced EDD.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance is mandatory for at least two joint authorized signatories at the designated Egyptian bank branch during onboarding; fully remote corporate onboarding is not available for newly formed LLCs. Non-resident directors/shareholders may delegate authority through a specific, notarized power of attorney (apostilled under the Hague Convention or legalized by the Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the respective consulate) in favor of a resident manager or local agent who opens the account in person. The bank will additionally conduct a video/KYC interview with the ultimate beneficial owner; nonetheless, original signed corporate resolutions, POAs, and constitutional documents must be physically archived at the branch to activate the account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident beneficial owners (offshore VC/angel investors) with no physical footprint in Egypt, raising shell-risk flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Arabic-translated LLC Articles of Association; Commercial Registry extract showing ISIC code 6201 and cloud-tools business scope; GAFI license/registration (if under Investment Law 72/2017); apostilled investor certificates of incorporation and chanting constitutional documents; executed Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement; clean source-of-funds statements (12-month) for each investor; group organizational chart; NSSA (social insurance) registration showing local technical staff; and a business plan evidencing substantive DevOps/API-monitoring operations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency small-value cross-border receipts from SaaS/API subscriptions with simultaneous outbound disbursements to foreign cloud processors (Stripe, AWS, Mercury ACH), resembling transaction laundering.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master SaaS/API license agreement and standardized worldwide order forms; product feature documentation confirming the observability infrastructure model; consolidated 13-month Stripe Billing and Mercury ACH statements; Egyptian Tax Authority VAT registration and e-invoice ledger (sequentially numbered); complete billing master and refund policy; AML/compliance policy signed by the board; and a narrative dossier explaining the company's reseller/ISV position in the cloud tooling value chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Export proceeds declared on re-invoicing or agent/reseller arrangements of foreign cloud services, raising risks of margin manipulation or transfer-pricing misstatement.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Intercompany reseller/distribution agreements and OEM-ISV license chain documents (e.g., AWS Partner Network, Stripe ISV agreements); original IP registration certificates or licenses held by the Egyptian entity; CBE export invoice declarations; transfer pricing documentation applying the CUP/TNMM methodology with net operating margin within the 12-15% range; board-approved pricing policy; and audited financial statements proving economic substance and assumption of risk.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Subscription user traffic originating from sanctioned or high-risk jurisdictions (e.g., Iran, Syria, DPRK, Sudan, Cuba) exposing the bank to OFAC/CBE sanctions liability.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Geoblocking and sanctioned-country deny-list policy; automated user KYB/KYC screening module output showing accepted jurisdictions; full sanctions list matching reports from a recognized screening vendor (Refinitiv/LexisNexis) on both customers and counterparties; contractual anti-embargo clauses in standard customer terms; and board-approved Export Controls and Sanctions Compliance Statement with clear enforcement procedures and an audit trail.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Foreign-equity capital injections must be remitted by SWIFT MT103 to the LLC's USD operational account at the primary Egyptian bank. The SWIFT narrative must clearly state: 'Capital Subscription for LLC Commercial Registry No. [number], GAFI Certificate No. [number] (if applicable), Tax ID No. [number]'. The receiving bank will request: (i) the LLC's Commercial Registry extract listing the foreign shareholders; (ii) the board/general assembly resolution approving the subscription or capital increase; (iii) the share allotment ledger; (iv) the inward remittance FX declaration form (CBE form 402/FX source declaration); and (v) the investor's incorporation certificate and board resolution authorizing the transfer. The bank records the funds at the prevailing dealing rate in USD or converts to EGP only upon explicit board instruction; matching of the credit to the company's capital file must be completed within 5 business days to enable future dividend and liquidation repatriation rights. Loans from shareholders are permitted and should be labeled 'Shareholder Loan Agreement dated [date]' with a full loan agreement on file; loan repayments are triggered only after CBE-required documentation is approved by the bank.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound clearing is divided among four rails: (1) local EGP operational outflows (payroll, local suppliers, office rent) via the Egyptian Instant Payment Network (IPN), Fawry, or direct debit at the clearing bank; (2) international software and cloud infrastructure disbursements (AWS, Stripe processing fees, global subcontractors) via SWIFT MT103 with pro-forma invoices, contracts, or subscription statements attached in the bank's trade file; (3) procurement of hardware or capitalized cloud infrastructure (if any) via Commercial Letters of Credit (MT700) issued by CIB/HSBC with transport/insurance documents only when physical goods are involved, otherwise by T/T MT103; and (4) corporate distributions on capital (dividends) to foreign shareholders via the same SWIFT rails, subject to CBE dividend-transfer application, audited financial statements, general assembly dividend minutes, tax withholding certificate (with treaty relief forms where applicable), and confirmation that underlying capital was repatriable under Investment Law 72/2017.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable USD/EGP FX forward contracts with authorized banks, maximum tenor 360 days, requiring an underlying current-account exposure (SaaS export invoices or incurred hosting costs) to be evidenced at trade inception.
USD/EGP FX swaps executed with the primary clearing bank for term mismatches between USD current-account cash inflows and EGP tax/operating obligations.

Offshore EGP non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) executed through the international branch or correspondent dealer of an Egyptian authorized bank, used solely for hedging non-resident group-level exposures and eligible for no-delivery settlement against CBE official exchange rate reference.
Cross-currency swaps (USD/EGP) for matched asset-liability funding of long-term intercompany loans, subject to CBE approval and submission of the underlying financing agreement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry Office, Ministry of Trade and Industry (via GAFI One-Stop-Shop)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers daily/late fines and interest; continued non-renewal beyond the grace period leads to administrative suspension and eventual strike-off from the Commercial Registry, restricting legal transactions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Tax Card (Tax Identification Card) Annual Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 January (calendar-year validity begins 1 January)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal incurs daily fines (approximately 2% of the annual card fee); prolonged delinquency may result in temporary suspension of the tax card, blocking bank clearances and government transactions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return and Audited Financial Statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after fiscal year-end (30 April for calendar-year filers)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of up to 2% per month on unpaid tax plus interest; failure to file may trigger estimated assessment, additional fines, and criminal prosecution for tax evasion.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Corporate & UBO Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, simultaneous with Commercial Registry renewal (by 31 January or within 30 days of any ownership change)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit UBO confirmation constitutes an AML violation, with fines up to EGP 100,000; repeated non-compliance may result in suspension of corporate registration and access to banking services.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No size-based exemption: all Egyptian LLCs, regardless of revenue, assets, or number of employees, must appoint a licensed auditor and submit audited annual financial statements under Companies Law No. 159/1981.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), substantially converged with IFRS; full IFRS is permitted for larger/listed entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Egyptian AML Law No. 80/2002 and its Executive Regulations require every LLC to maintain an internal UBO register and file annual confirmation with GAFI. Any transfer of shares resulting in a change of 10% or more ownership must be reported to GAFI within 30 days; annual confirmation is required alongside the Commercial Registry renewal.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book (General Assembly and Board of Managers meetings)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 250 – 1,200 (market range for registered agent or local office services in Egypt)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 500 – 2,000 (typical accredited auditor fee for a small developer-tools LLC)

stage_6.triggering_act: Submitting Form No. 6 with falsified revenue/expense data, double invoicing, or destroying accounting records to reduce taxable profit.
stage_6.statutory_sanction: Fine of 100%-300% of evaded tax, imprisonment up to 5 years, 2%/month late surcharge on all unpaid tax, and mandatory publication in the ETA's non-compliant taxpayer list.
stage_6.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false returns are jointly and severally liable for the evaded tax, face seizure of personal bank accounts and travel bans by ETA application to the competent court, and can be imprisoned.
